entities.name: Aegar, the Freezing Flame
entities.description: Giant wizard of Kaldheim, child of a fire giant king and a frost giant matron.

entities.name: Kaldar
entities.description: King of the fire giants and Aegar's father.

entities.name: Frost giants
entities.description: Giants among whom Aegar was raised.

entities.name: Fire giants
entities.description: Giants ruled by Kaldar whom Aegar sought out.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion in which Aegar fought in defense of Kaldheim.

events.summary: Kaldar has a secret affair with a frost giant matron, producing Aegar.
events.quote: Kaldar , the king of the fire giants, had a secret affair with one of the frost giant matrons

events.summary: Aegar's powers manifest and he makes a pilgrimage to the fire giants to find his father, defeating those who disparaged him.
events.quote: quickly earned his place by handily defeating those who disparaged him

events.summary: Kaldar meets Aegar and is overjoyed to learn of his son.
events.quote: Kaldar was overjoyed to meet the son he didn't know he had

events.summary: Aegar fights in defense of Kaldheim during the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Aegar fought in defense of Kaldheim during the New Phyrexian Invasion

relations.quote: That affair produced a child: Aegar
the king of the fire giants
